THE CLAUSE

This document also includes some default user-level instructions, which users or developers can explicitly override.

CLAUSES IT CROSS-REFERENCES

User: Instructions from end users.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 the document includes default user-level instructions
  C2 users can explicitly override such a default instruction
  C3 developers can explicitly override such a default instruction

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «the user level of instruction authority: instructions from end users»
  1. «an instruction included in the document by default at the user level of authority»
  2. «O is an explicit override of default instruction I»
  3. «the developer level of instruction authority: instructions from developers»
  4. I is «I is a default user-level instruction included in the document» when «the user level of instruction authority: instructions from end users»
  5. clause l1_170_n057 permits ⟨act override_default_instruction(I)⟩ when «I is a default user-level instruction included in the document» and «O is an explicit override of default instruction I»
